title: Returned-Payment Relativity on Named Non-Owner Policy Reinstatement Re-Writes
content:
When a Named Non-Owner Policy term is reinstated with a lapse, payments recently returned unpaid carry a relativity on the reinstatement re-write premium.

**Count.** The payments returned unpaid on any billing plan of the named insured — every plan the named insured holds with the Installment Payment Plans product, not only the plan of this term — whose posting date lies fewer than 12 whole months before the processing date, a month being complete on the same day of the following month.

| Returned payments in the 12 whole months | Relativity |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 1.08 |
| exactly 1 | 1.04 |
| none | none |

The relativity multiplies the reinstatement re-write premium before that figure is rounded to the cent.

**Window boundary (hypothetical; processing date 20 May).** A returned payment posted on 21 May of the previous year lies fewer than 12 whole months before and is counted; one posted on 20 May of the previous year lies 12 whole months before and is not. A returned payment on the named insured's Owner Auto Policy plan counts in the same way as one on the non-owner plan.
